{{2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2021–22 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team''' represented [[Vanderbilt University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by third-year head coach [[Jerry Stackhouse]], and played their home games at [[Memorial Gymnasium (Vanderbilt University)|Memorial Gymnasium]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 19–17, 7–11 in [[2021–22 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC Play]] to finish in eleventh place. They defeated [[2021–22 Georgia Bulldogs basketball team|Georgia]] and [[2021–22 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] to advance to the quarterfinals of the [[2022 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] where they lost to [[2021–22 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2021–22 Belmont Bruins men's basketball team|Belmont]] and [[2021–22 Dayton Flyers men's basketball team|Dayton]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2021–22 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]].

==Previous season==
In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]],<ref>{{Cite web|date=2020-09-16|title=NCAA: Men's, women's hoops can start Nov. 25|url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/story/_/id/29900866/sources-ncaa-college-basketball-season-start-nov-25|access-date=2021-08-24|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> the [[2020–21 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Commodores]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 9–16, 3–13 in [[2020–21 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in last place. They defeated [[2020–21 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] in the first round of the [[2021 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=Texas A&M vs. Vanderbilt – Game Recap – March 10, 2021 – ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401287130|access-date=2021-08-24|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> but lost to [[2020–21 Florida Gators men's basketball team|Florida]] in the second round.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Vanderbilt vs. Florida – Game Recap – March 11, 2021 – ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401287132|access-date=2021-08-24|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref>
